title: Marvelous Designer 2024.2 Automatic Conversion Quadrilateral Surface Algorithm Optimization
description:
In version 2024.2, we have improved the Quad Surface (Optimized) algorithm for plates, and now the automatically converted quad surfaces will be neater and cleaner!

After selecting the plate, right-click on it, choose Mesh Type → Quad Surface (Optimized) to convert it to a quad surface with one click. Additionally, after selecting the plate, go to the Property Editor, where you can find the Mesh Type under Geometry, and switch to Quad Surface (Optimized) for automatic quad surface conversion.

summary: ```# Marvelous Designer 2024.2: Automatic Conversion Quadrilateral Surface Algorithm Optimization ## Introduction to the Four-Sided Algorithm In this video, we discuss how to improve the four-sided algorithm used in the grid array optimization process. The four-sided optimization type has undergone significant improvements in the latest version. ## Previous Version Challenges In the previous version, we switched the grid type to the four-sided optimization option for a specific set of clothes. However, after making this switch, we encountered issues where strange four-sided shapes appeared in some unnecessary places. When high-quality rendering was activated, the preview often resulted in artifacts resembling outputs from other software. The unreasonable placement of these grid lines led to some grid points being squeezed out, which resulted in an unideal rough effect. ## Improvements in the New Version With the release of the new version, we have achieved a more neat and clean four-sided grid array. The unnecessary four-sided edges have been eliminated. This version features a more reasonable grid line configuration, ensuring that the clothing will not appear in the same problematic places as before. ## Visual Comparisons Please check the comparison picture provided. You will notice that the four sides of the four-sided optimization now feature more rational grid lines. ## Conclusion on Grid Type Adjustments In the previous version, the grid type of four-sided optimization was shifted multiple times for this set of clothes. After the sixth generation, the grid type has become more logical and effective. You can see that there is now more room within the four-sided optimization option for this set of clothes. The grid lines have been adjusted to be more reasonable, leading to an overall improvement in the final output. I hope you recognize the differences in the properties of the four-sided optimization option and the adjustments made to the grid type for clothing designs. ```
